top_signals.title: China Encourages Cinemas to Add Sports Events and Lottery Sales
top_signals.summary: China is encouraging cinemas to screen major sporting events, host sports activities and sell sports lottery tickets as part of a drive to link moviegoing with sports consumption, according to a notice from the National Film Administration and General Administration of Sport.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
